audit.whatIsWrong: Her poke was repeatedly called 'shuriken (E)'. Five Point Strike (Q) is the five-kunai poke on a 1.5s cooldown; Shuriken Flip (E) is the marked-target flip-and-dash. Assassin's Mark's auto-reset tell was absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q throws five kunai and slows; E flips backward, marks, and re-casts into a dash. Confusing the two makes the step-up rule fire on the wrong ability. Steadfast Presence (W) does stop both the E recast dash and Perfect Execution (R) — that is correct and now stated with numbers. Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable, so a targeted E has no target.
audit.corrected: Q named Five Point Strike, E kept as the dash Poppy's W eats, and the auto-reset named as the burst tell rather than the ability cast.

edits.before: Akali is squishy and energy-gated at levels 1-3, and that's your whole window. The instant she steps up to throw a shuriken (E) or auto, dash her into a wall with your E for the stun, then Q the spot — your hammer deals max-HP damage so even a fed Akali gets chunked off a single slam. Don't waste E chasing into her Twilight Shroud (W) — once she's invisible your E has no target, so bait the shroud out first or E her before she can drop it.
edits.after: Akali is squishy and energy-gated at levels 1-3, and that's your whole window. The instant she steps up for Five Point Strike (Q) or an auto, dash her into a wall with your E for the stun, then Q the spot — your hammer deals max-HP damage so even a fed Akali gets chunked off a single slam. Don't waste E into her Twilight Shroud (W), 20s: inside it she is unselectable, so your targeted E has no target — bait the smoke out, or E her before she can drop it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are even — your flat damage stops scaling while she stacks AP, so trade off Q max-HP chunk and resets, not raw burst. At 6 her R is the swing: she two-part dashes past your E and can execute or flee, and shroud blanks your targeted slam. Save your W for the exact moment she dashes in — Steadfast Presence grounds her R dash, stops it cold, and strips her escape so your E-wall-Q can finish.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are even — your flat damage stops scaling while she stacks AP, so trade off Q max-HP chunk and resets, not raw burst. At 6 her R is the swing on a 120s cooldown: she two-part dashes past your E and can execute or flee, and shroud blanks your targeted slam. Save W for the exact moment she dashes in — Steadfast Presence stops the dash, then grounds and slows her, stripping the escape so E-wall-Q finishes.
